name: Statistics
description: Summary statistics and percentiles for lists of numbers.

operations.name: stats.summary
operations.description: Computes count, sum, mean, min, and max over a list of numbers.

inputs.name: values
inputs.description: Array of numbers; entries that are not numbers are skipped

operations.howto: Bind values from a state key that already holds an array of numbers, seeded in initialState or written by other operations. No transform extracts one field from every item of an array, so when list items are objects, keep the numeric series in its own state key. Route each output you need to a state key with an output binding and bind text elements to those keys. An empty list returns zeros instead of an error.

operations.name: stats.percentile
operations.description: Computes the p-th percentile of a list of numbers with linear interpolation.

inputs.name: values
inputs.description: Array of numbers; entries that are not numbers are skipped

operations.howto: Bind values the same way as stats.summary. Bind p as a constant with a typed numeric value, for example value 95 for the 95th percentile. The operation sorts the numbers and interpolates linearly between the two closest ranks, so p 50 is the median. Route the value output to a state key. An empty list is an error, and p outside 0 to 100 is an error.
